fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) achieved three-digit percentage gains in 2026, with Q3 results showing data center revenue nearly doubling and margins improving significantly, with revisiting all-time highs appearing imminent.
fields.summary_ko.1: Data center revenue surged from $4.34 billion in Q3 2025 (+22% YoY) to $8.55 billion in Q3 2026 (+97%), with data center operating margin expanding 9 points from 25% to 34%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Data center now accounts for 64% of total revenue, with 2027 guidance of annual compound revenue growth of 35% or higher justifying market valuation multiples.
